details:
- CVE-2026-110879: validate type parameters and array element types of polymorphic type ids
- behaviour change from that fix: an array type id approved only by a name-based or
  array-depth BasicPolymorphicTypeValidator rule, or whose element type is abstract or an
  interface, now needs its element type allow-listed explicitly (allowIfSubType(Bar[].class)
  still covers element type Bar)
